cues.text: I finally did my laundry today.
I’d been putting it off all week, and this morning I realised I had no clean socks left.
So that was my sign.
I put a load on, made some coffee, and sat down for a bit.
I always tell myself I’ll clean the kitchen while the washing machine’s running, but today I just didn’t feel like it.
A friend called while I was waiting, and we ended up talking for almost an hour.
Nothing special—just work, dinner plans, that kind of thing.
It was nice to have a chat without having to be anywhere.
Anyway, I got the washing out and hung everything up.
And now it’s all dry, sitting on my bed, waiting for me to put it away.
That’s the part I always leave until later.
Washing it?
Fine.
Hanging it up?
Fine.
Putting it away?
Somehow, that feels like a whole other job.
But at least I’ve caught up on the laundry.
Well, almost.
I’ll probably move the clothes onto the chair when I go to bed.
